description: Rasterize the targets into an embedded image (Object > Rasterize), with the dialog's options: colour model, resolution, background, anti-aliasing, clipping mask, space added around the object, spot colours, text to outlines and layer attributes. By default the targets become one image; clipBounds limits it to a rectangle. The vector originals are removed

antiAliasing.description: none, art (Art Optimized, supersampling) or type (Type Optimized, hinted). Default art

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

clipBounds.description: Rasterize only this rectangle, in points from the artboard's top-left corner

clippingMask.description: Create Clipping Mask: mask the background. Default false

colorModel.description: default: the document's colour mode. Default default

convertTextToOutlines.description: Outline text before rasterizing. Default false

includeLayers.description: Keep layer opacity and blending in the image. Default false

padding.description: Add Around Object, in points. Default 0

preserveSpotColors.description: Keep spot colours; false converts them to process. Default true

resolution.description: Pixels per inch: 72 screen, 150 medium, 300 high. Default 300

separately.description: One image per target instead of one for all. Default false

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: rasterize_items
title: Rasterize Items
